items.title: Trump breaks silence, demands Congress fund air traffic control
items.feedTitle: Trump breaks silence on nationwide ground stop and demands more money from Congress
items.summary: President Trump called on Congress to fund a new air traffic control system following Friday's rare nationwide ground stop that disrupted air travel for hours. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy blamed predecessors and Congress for failing to adequately fund the nation's aging system. The four-hour ground stop, the longest in 25 years, was attributed to equipment issues during a contractor's telecom network upgrade in Arkansas.

items.title: SpaceX captures Starship booster in historic first
items.feedTitle: SpaceX's Starship returns from orbit and is captured by launch pad arms in a dramatic first
items.summary: SpaceX achieved a historic first by capturing its Starship booster mid-air using mechanical arms nicknamed 'chopsticks' during Friday's test flight from Texas. However, the first-stage booster exploded shortly after liftoff, preventing the desired double catch of both rocket and spacecraft. The spacecraft itself successfully reached orbit in the company's boldest test yet.

items.title: New Orleans port sues tanker owners for $1 million cruise ship damage
items.feedTitle: New Orleans port sues tanker owners over cruise ship collision for $1m
items.summary: The Board of Commissioners of the Port of New Orleans filed a lawsuit against the owners of the Atlantic Asphalt tanker that struck a cruise ship on the Mississippi River on Friday, seeking over $1 million in damages to the terminal. The collision injured more than 30 people but resulted in no fatalities. A federal judge issued a warrant giving officials control of the ship for the lawsuit.

items.title: Iran targets US military base in Bahrain with drones
items.feedTitle: Iran targets US military base in Bahrain with drone attack
items.summary: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps launched a drone attack on a US military base in Bahrain on Sunday, marking the second attack on the country in three days. Bahrain said it intercepted the incoming drones, and officials said the strike targeted radar installations. The attack comes amid ongoing US-Iran tensions over the Strait of Hormuz and regional conflicts.

items.title: Early flu season hits South and West as CDC reports surge
items.feedTitle: The U.S. flu season is off to a very early start. It's hitting the South and West now
items.summary: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reported that seven states had high flu activity in the latest update, up from two states the week before, indicating the US flu season is off to a very early start. The surge is currently concentrated in the South and West regions. Health officials are urging residents to consider flu vaccination as cases rise.

stlouis.title: Missouri Sen. Schmitt backs $30B aviation modernization bill
stlouis.feedTitle: Missouri Sen. Eric Schmitt pushes $30 billion aviation modernization bill after FAA ground stop
stlouis.summary: Missouri Senator Eric Schmitt is pushing a $30 billion aviation modernization bill in response to Friday's nationwide FAA ground stop. The proposal aims to modernize the country's aging air traffic control system, which failed during a contractor's equipment upgrade in Arkansas. Schmitt's bill addresses the need for updated infrastructure to prevent future disruptions.

stlouis.title: Brady Tkachuk leads Panthers past Blues in special game
stlouis.feedTitle: Brady Tkachuk leads Panthers past Blues on special night for his father
stlouis.summary: Brady Tkachuk led the Florida Panthers to a 4-1 victory over the St. Louis Blues in what was described as a special night for his father. The Blues' offense was stifled in the loss, continuing the team's recent struggles. Tkachuk's performance highlighted a dominant Panthers team.

stlouis.title: St. Louis police fatally shoot armed suspect on Meramec
stlouis.feedTitle: St. Louis police fatally shoot armed man on Meramec Street
stlouis.summary: St. Louis police fatally shot an armed man on Meramec Street in a police-involved shooting. Details on the circumstances of the encounter remain limited, but authorities confirmed the shooting occurred during an officer response. The incident is under investigation.

items.title: Czech Republic holds massive rally against media funding changes
items.feedTitle: Hundreds of thousands of Czechs protest in Prague over media freedom
items.summary: An estimated 350,000 people gathered in Prague on Sunday to protest the government's plan to scrap mandatory broadcast licence fees and switch to state budget funding. Critics say the proposed changes would give the government more control over public broadcasters and stifle media freedom. The rally represents one of the largest public demonstrations in recent Czech history against what protesters view as threats to press independence.

items.title: Estonia closes border with Russia after sabotage attacks
items.feedTitle: Estonia prepares to close border with Russia after GRU-linked sabotage attacks
items.summary: Estonia announced plans to close border crossings with Russia following GRU-linked sabotage attacks, including a failed arson attempt at a drone manufacturing facility. The closure comes as tensions escalate over alleged Russian efforts to destabilize the NATO member state. Eight people were detained in connection with the attempted arson attack.

items.title: World court to rule on Myanmar genocide against Rohingya
items.feedTitle: World’s top court to rule if Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya
items.summary: The International Court of Justice will deliver a landmark judgment this week on whether Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya minority. The ruling marks a historic moment as the world's top court has never before found a state guilty of genocide. The decision will have implications for similar cases, including allegations against Israel.

items.title: Trump, Putin, Xi plan historic joint meeting in China
items.feedTitle: Trump, Putin and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week, White House says
items.summary: Trump, Putin, and Xi Jinping plan to hold an unprecedented historic joint meeting in China next week, according to the White House. Trump will discuss 'reduction of nuclear weapons' during the talks, marking a rare trilateral summit between the three leaders. The meeting underscores Trump's diplomatic approach during his presidency.

items.title: South Korea tax exam top scorer admits AI cheating scheme
items.feedTitle: 160 questions, only one wrong: top scorer in South Korea tax exam admits AI cheating
items.summary: Han Won-seok, 34, the top scorer on South Korea's national tax accountancy exam, confessed to using a hidden camera and AI to achieve a near-perfect mark on the significant test. The admission has raised concerns about exam integrity and the potential misuse of AI technology. Authorities are investigating whether other test-takers may have engaged in similar cheating.

items.title: India's government health spending triples to ₹4.14 lakh crore
items.feedTitle: India’s health spending triples to ₹4.14 lakh crore, but out-of-pocket share drops to 42.7%: NHA
items.summary: India's government health spending more than tripled to ₹4.14 lakh crore over a decade, while the share of healthcare costs borne by households fell from 64.2% to 42.7%, according to the National Health Authority. Social security spending on health rose from 6% to 11% during the same period. The shift reflects increased public investment in healthcare infrastructure and reduced out-of-pocket burden on families.

items.title: India, US agree on preferential market access for Indian goods
items.feedTitle: India, U.S. agreed on preferential market access for Indian goods in America: Goyal
items.summary: India and the US agreed on preferential market access for Indian goods in America, according to Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal. The deal, initially scheduled to be signed earlier, faced delays due to changes in the US tariff landscape requiring further negotiations. Lower tariffs than rival nations were already agreed upon by both sides.

items.title: India pulled 500 million from poverty, many still struggle
items.feedTitle: India pulled 500m people out of poverty. Many of them still barely survive
items.summary: India has pulled approximately 500 million people out of extreme poverty over the past 12-13 years, according to World Bank data cited by PM Modi. However, many of those lifted from poverty still barely survive on minimal incomes, raising questions about the sustainability of gains. The report highlights the ongoing challenges of ensuring quality of life improvements beyond income thresholds.

items.title: ICC confirms India hosts 2029 Champions Trophy, 2031 ODI World Cup
items.feedTitle: India to host 2029 Champions Trophy, co-host 2031 ODI World Cup, confirms ICC
items.summary: The International Cricket Council confirmed that India will host the 2029 Champions Trophy and co-host the 2031 ODI World Cup. The announcement solidifies India's position as a major venue for international cricket tournaments. India will share hosting duties for the 2031 World Cup with another nation.

items.title: Activist Sonam Wangchuk placed under 60-day house arrest
items.feedTitle: Activist Sonam Wangchuk Under 60-Day House Arrest Over Ladakh Anti-Poll Protest
items.summary: Activist Sonam Wangchuk, known for environmental and educational work in Ladakh, has been placed under a 60-day house arrest by the Ladakh administration under Section 163 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023. The restrictions were imposed over his anti-poll protest activities. A Ladakh civil society group has characterized the action as administrative high-handedness.

immigration.title: US Labor Department warns H-1B cannot be used as business model
immigration.feedTitle: More companies may face action in H-1B probe, warns US Labour Department's Anthony D’Esposito
immigration.summary: US Labor Department official Anthony D'Esposito warned that H-1B visas cannot be used as a business model and signaled further suspensions in a widening immigration fraud probe. The warning targets Indian IT giants Infosys, TCS, and Wipro over H-1B visa abuse. More companies may face action as the department escalates scrutiny on visa misuse, proposed and not final.

immigration.title: US revokes over 6,000 visas in birth tourism crackdown
immigration.feedTitle: Crackdown Against Birth Tourism: US Cancels 6000 Visas
immigration.summary: The United States revoked more than 6,000 visas of foreigners linked to birth tourism participation or facilitation, the State Department announced. The crackdown reflects tougher immigration enforcement targeting parents who travel to the US specifically to give birth and obtain citizenship for their children. This represents one of the largest visa revocations on record, finalized and in effect.

immigration.title: DHS proposes ending USCIS deference on H-1B extensions
immigration.feedTitle: DHS wants every H-1B extension reviewed from scratch; the rule is only proposed and comments close November 13
immigration.summary: The Department of Homeland Security proposed ending USCIS deference to prior approvals on H-1B and other I-129 visa extensions, requiring all renewals to be reviewed from scratch. The change could impact approximately 208,000 work visa renewals and trigger an estimated 6,000 additional Requests for Evidence (RFEs). The rule is proposed, with comments closing November 13, not yet finalized.

items.title: Treasury Secretary calls for Nvidia leadership overhaul
items.feedTitle: Bessent Says Nvidia Needs ‘Dramatic Shakeup’ After Huang Ouster
items.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent called for a 'dramatic shakeup' at Nvidia, urging the company to seek an external CEO amid the scandal involving founder Jensen Huang and export control scrutiny. Bessent's public call for new leadership reflects concerns about Nvidia's direction following Huang's departure. The statement signals broader concerns about AI chip export controls and corporate governance at the semiconductor giant.

items.title: Nvidia scandal wipes thousands off investor 401(k) accounts
items.feedTitle: How Nvidia's scandal knocked thousands off your 401(k)
items.summary: The scandal involving Nvidia founder Jensen Huang's affair and alleged connections to a suspected Chinese spy has knocked thousands of dollars off investor retirement accounts, as Nvidia's stock tumbled. Many individual investors hold Nvidia shares through diversified index funds and 401(k) plans, meaning the decline affects a broad swathe of Americans. The decline reflects broader concerns about AI sector valuations.

items.title: India's stock market rebounds as AI retreat fuels rotation
items.feedTitle: AI retreat fuels India's stock market comeback in great rotation trade
items.summary: India's stock market is experiencing a comeback as the 'great rotation' trade gains momentum following weakness in US AI stocks. Short covering and foreign inflows are fueling the Indian market rebound, with investors rotating out of expensive tech names into emerging market equities. The shift reflects a reassessment of valuations after the AI sector's recent turbulence.

items.title: US home sales hit 16-year low amid mortgage rate surge
items.feedTitle: Home sales hit 16-year low in October amid soaring mortgage rates
items.summary: US existing home sales fell to a 16-year low in October, dropping 8.8% year-over-year to 3.75 million units, as buyers were driven away by high mortgage rates near three-year highs and rising inflation. The weak sales data reflects persistent affordability challenges in the housing market. Elevated mortgage rates continue to dampen buyer demand despite recent economic data.

items.title: Global oil supply swings to surplus as Iran war pressures ease
items.feedTitle: Global oil supply returns to surplus for first time since start of Iran war, says IEA
items.summary: The world's oil supply swung back to a surplus for the first time since the start of the US-Israeli war against Iran, with supplies outstripping demand by nearly 2 million barrels a day in October, according to the International Energy Agency. The shift signals tentative signs of market rebalancing after months of supply concerns. Lower geopolitical tension and increased production are easing pressure on prices.

finance.note: Oil markets shifted to supply surplus for the first time since the Iran war's onset, with WTI pressure easing as geopolitical tensions cool; US stock futures indicated lower as inflation concerns and rate-hike fears weigh on equities, though Indian markets rebounded on foreign inflows and rotation out of US tech. cards.title: Constraints forge novelty
cards.insight: The best creative breakthroughs often emerge not from unlimited resources but from scarcity: limited time, budget, or tools force unexpected combinations and force prioritization of core ideas. Friction with limits drives lateral thinking.
cards.takeaway: Set artificial constraints on your next project—time, tools, or scope—and use them to force creative recombination instead of defaulting to what works.

cards.title: Authenticity amplifies reach
cards.insight: Creators who share genuine struggle, doubt, or failure often resonate more deeply than polished perfection. Audiences connect to vulnerability and recognize the messy, iterative process behind finished work. Transparency builds trust and credibility.
cards.takeaway: Show process, not just product. Share what didn't work or what surprised you—it humanizes your work and invites audience participation in the creative journey.

cards.title: Crossing disciplines sparks invention
cards.insight: Most original ideas live at intersections—where one field's convention meets another's assumption. A poet's metaphor applied to engineering, a chef's layering technique applied to design, or a musician's rhythm applied to narrative all create novelty unavailable within silos.
cards.takeaway: When stuck, borrow a principle from an unrelated discipline: how would a biologist, architect, or improviser solve this? Unexpected adjacencies unlock new directions.

cards.title: Iteration beats inspiration
cards.insight: The myth of the lone genius receiving a flash of brilliance obscures the truth: most creators ship first versions that are mediocre and improve through cycles of feedback, refinement, and failure. Consistency and volume beat waiting for the perfect idea.
cards.takeaway: Ship something imperfect today rather than perfecting nothing. Use real feedback, not imagination, to guide the next version.

ai.title: Anthropic's IPO lands amid embattled AI trade downturn
ai.feedTitle: Anthropic’s IPO lands as the embattled AI trade looks for a much-needed bright spot
ai.summary: Anthropic's highly anticipated IPO arrived as the broader AI sector faced significant headwinds following the Jensen Huang scandal at Nvidia and concerns over AI valuations. The company is targeting approximately $1.4 trillion valuation and seeks to become a major test of investor appetite for AI infrastructure companies. The IPO timing comes as the industry grapples with questions about AI spending priorities and governance.

ai.title: Huang's exit puts Nvidia's open source AI commitment in question
ai.feedTitle: Jensen Huang’s exit puts Nvidia’s support for open source in question
ai.summary: Jensen Huang's resignation from Nvidia raises questions about the company's future support for open source AI initiatives, including its Hugging Face acquisition, open-weight models, and advocacy against AI restrictions. The leadership transition creates uncertainty about Nvidia's strategic direction on these fronts. Hugging Face CEO pledged to continue fighting for open source AI despite the leadership change.

ai.title: Google's Gemini 4 Hydrogen powers improved Search answers
ai.feedTitle: Google’s latest Search upgrade promises better answers to your most complicated questions
ai.summary: Google announced an upgrade to its AI Mode, powered by Gemini 4 Hydrogen, that promises better answers to complex queries and improved link surfacing. The new model aims to deliver richer visual responses and more sophisticated understanding of user intent. The update represents Google's push to compete with ChatGPT and other advanced AI assistants.
